column3: “House of Yahweh” (the second) is rendered “the Lord's house.”
“Were seeing when the fire came down” is rendered “seeing the fire come down.” NASB supplies “saying” and “Truly” twice; “to give thanks” is rendered “gave praise.”
“On their duties” is rendered “at their posts”; NASB supplies “for giving praise,” renders “by their hand” as “by their means,” and supplies “on the other side.”
“Lebo Hamath” is rendered “the entrance of Hamath,” and “the wadi of Egypt” as “the brook of Egypt”; NASB supplies “who came.”
“Good of heart” is rendered “happy of heart,” and “on the good” as “because of the goodness.”
“Every thing which was coming on the heart of Solomon” is rendered “all that he had planned on doing,” and “he made successful” as “successfully completed.”
“A throne of your kingdom” is rendered “your royal throne,” and “made” as “covenanted.” “A man will not be cut off to you” is rendered “You shall not lack a man.”
The Hebrew has “them”; NASB reads “you.” “Pluck up” is rendered “uproot,” and “a byword and a taunt” as “a proverb and a byword.”
“Took hold on” is rendered “adopted,” and “calamity” as “adversity.”
